snippet.title: Mawang: Dark Lord Defense Prologue Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official channel for Mawang: Dark Lord Defense!

Dive into this real-time tactical tower defense game where Princess Lua, daughter of the Dark Lord, must defend her demon realm against an invading hero alliance. Command unique towers, manage morale, and devise deep strategies across diverse, challenging battlefields. Master tactical pauses to turn the tide and climb global leaderboards! Experience a unique blend of strategy and psychological warfare as you fight for the fate of the demon realm.

Add Mawang: Dark Lord Defense to your Wishlist on Steam now and get the latest news first!
